answer: Weight an identity only after it redeems one personhood credential drawn from a bounded lagoon of enrolled humans, each person issuing a single pearl. Every pearl carries a cipher nullifier bound to the key, so one human cannot back two identities without a visible collision. A farm running N clones must find N distinct humans, a supply no operator or coalition can manufacture, so weight per fake falls toward zero. At settlement the ledger rechecks each nullifier and burns the collateral behind any repeated or forged pearl.
